name: Dominika Dmitrzak
researchKeywords: regional inequalities, internal migration, spatial stratification, political economy of health
bio: Dominika Dmitrzak is a PhD student in Human Geography at Newcastle University. Her research examines how internal migration affects regional inequalities and spatial stratification in England.
researchFocus: Dominika studies whether and how the movement of people between regions reinforces spatial and socioeconomic inequalities. Her project combines analysis of migration patterns with interviews about people's reasons for moving and the effects of migration on places.
